raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 15
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread and swapped the IMDb release dates: it claimed Tiger of the Seven Seas had an October 1952 UK release and My Wife’s Lodger had a December 23, 1962 Italy release. In fact, IMDb shows Tiger of the Seven Seas’ earliest release as Italy, December 23, 1962, and My Wife’s Lodger’s earliest release as UK, October 1952. This inversion led to the incorrect conclusion that Tiger of the Seven Seas was released earlier.
